text: An agent is a program that reads a request, picks its own tools, and uses them.
Our campaign pipelines were separate jobs, and someone had to start each with the right settings.
I designed and built one agent to sit in front of them all.
You send it one plain-English sentence, like: schedule a marketing campaign for the next day.
The agent sets that sentence beside its four tools.
Create a campaign, scrape product data, search web trends, check a running job.
A language model running on Cloudflare reads both, and answers with a plan in JSON.
say: A language model running on Cloudflare reads both, and answers with a plan in jay-son.

text: Each action names a tool, its settings, and the reason for it.
The agent pulls the plan out of the reply and checks each tool name.
Then it starts each job as a Cloudflare Workflow, which saves its progress step by step.
It sends back its decision trail, so you can see what it chose and why.
I also published it as an MCP server, the standard way AI tools call each other.
say: I also published it as an M C P server, the standard way AI tools call each other.

text: Other agents and Claude clients reach it over SSE, HTTP, or RPC.
say: Other agents and Claude clients reach it over S S E, H T T P, or R P C.

text: The new scheduler hands its jobs to it too.
